text.value:
Your goal is to help Anna become famous by taking fun photos for her Starmaker page.





You can take one photo per day in the kitchen to start. But fame won’t come from the same backdrop forever.

Explore Peak City to find new locations, better lighting… and bigger opportunities.
Hint: Some events, characters, and locations unlock as the days pass.

You can explore the city freely and visit any unlocked location at your own pace.





There are no time-sensitive quests. Take your time, relax, and discover new opportunities when you’re ready.

Every corner of Peak City has something (or someone) worth finding.

Hint: Buying new cameras improves photo quality and boosts daily earnings.
Unlock new Perks on the Starmaker page to grow faster.

Each night, your Starmaker earnings are tallied based on Anna’s photos, engagement, and popularity.





Every week, a small follower drop is normal... attention fades fast on Starmaker.

Visit the Starmaker page to unlock Perks to keep Anna’s rise to fame steady.

Hint: New quests sometimes appear through 
messages on the Starmaker page.

Useit at the PC in your home to unlock powerful bonuses that boost Anna’s growth and income.





Earn more Perk Points by gaining XP. take photos, complete side quests, and play minigames to level up your Starmaker Page!

Hint: Give Anna a gift to boost her mood.
You can give one per day, so make it count.

Anna’s mood changes how likely she is to take great or bad photos.




Great photos give an XP boost, while bad ones give nothing.

It is normal for her mood to dip sometimes. Everyone has bad days, so give her time to recover and she will bounce back.
Hint: You can check her current tendency on the Status Page in the top right corner to see which route she’s leaning toward.

Build trust and affection to guide her toward the Love Route, focusing on closeness and emotional connection.







Encourage boldness and riskier decisions to unlock the Slut Route, where fame and desire take the lead.

Every choice matters, and once her path begins to form, it will change how the story unfolds.
Hover near the top center of the screen
The Menu Bar allows you to save the game at your room, to quit the game, to mute the music or adjust the dialogue speed.
